auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Wire2Air API key sent with the apikey header. Generate one in the Wire2Air dashboard under Manage Account > Manage API Keys at https://mzone.wire2air.com.

actions.name: list_inbound_messages
actions.description: List inbound SMS and MMS messages from the Wire2Air inbox.

dateFrom.description: Start date in M/D/YYYY format; the date range cannot exceed 31 days.

dateTo.description: End date in M/D/YYYY format; the date range cannot exceed 31 days.

textNumber.description: Assigned shortcode or text number to filter by.

page.description: Result page to retrieve; defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: Number of messages to return; defaults to 10.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing Wire2Air inbox messages.

PageNo.description: Current page number returned by Wire2Air.

RowStart.description: One-based index of the first row on this page.

RowEnd.description: One-based index of the last row on this page.

ListItems.description: Inbound SMS or MMS messages on this page.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Queue an SMS message or comma-separated bulk SMS messages with Wire2Air.

to.description: Destination number in international format, or comma-separated destination numbers for bulk sending.

deliveryDateTime.description: Optional UTC delivery time in MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS format.

replyPath.description: Callback URL that Wire2Air should use for message replies.

batchName.description: Internal reporting name used for a bulk message batch.

inputSchema.description: Input for sending an SMS message with Wire2Air.

Response.description: Human-readable submission status returned by Wire2Air.

URI.description: Relative URI for the queued message or batch.

ID.description: Identifier for the queued message or batch.

Type.description: Result type, such as Out or Batch.
